This editorial illustration features a green background with a red vertical border on the left. The top displays the red word "TEMPO" in a large, serif font. Two men in white long-sleeved shirts dominate the center. The man on the left has light skin, short dark hair, and a smiling expression. He wears a white skullcap and holds a long strip of white fabric above his head. His arms are raised, and his hands grasp the cloth, which extends to the right.

The figure on the right has a smooth, featureless black head and neck. This figure wears a white turban and a blue bag with a strap across the chest. The figure's left hand, covered in a black glove, holds a white megaphone. The white cloth from the left man is being wrapped around this second figure's turban.

Bold black text in the lower center reads "JOKO ROYO-ROYO." Smaller black text below discusses political perceptions and interactions. The bottom left contains a barcode and the date "6-12 AGUSTUS 2018." Other text at the top mentions domestic coal and license plate machines.
